name: SciDraw AI 中文官网

description: Chinese tutorials, templates, and entry points into SciDraw AI tools for research figures and data visualization. 中文教程、模板与 SciDraw AI 工具入口，面向科研绘图与数据可视化。This is the Chinese portal of the SciDraw AI brand (same product as sci-draw.com), helping researchers and students create paper figures, technical roadmaps and graphical abstracts.
